title: test suite writes synthetic prove_run events into the real project ledger (cwd not isolated)
detail: Every full-suite run appends ~12 fake prove_run events (e.g. command printf '7 passed in 0.1s', 'Files: 523') to the engine's real .sprint/ledger.jsonl, tagged with the active sprint's feature/phase. tests/test_prove.py and tests/test_criteria_kind_inference.py call prove.run without a temp project: conftest pops CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR but leaves cwd at the repo root, so ledger.project_root() walks up to the engine's .sprint/. Visible effect: sprint advance's full-suite ADVISORY reads the last prove_run and reports 'the proven run executed 7 test(s)' right after a real 1596-test prove. Fix at the source: the suite must never resolve a real project root (hermetic cwd per test), plus a guard that fails the session if the repo ledger changes.

resolution.verify: CUR=$(prusik --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+' | head -1); [ -n "$CUR" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' '0.227.1' "$CUR" | sort -V | head -1)" = '0.227.1' ] && echo "1 passed: engine carries moat-proven fix fb-f3f196654458 (prusik $CUR >= 0.227.1)"
